title: WordPress user accounts are listed through the REST API
summary: The WordPress REST users endpoint returns the account list, which names the users and their login slugs to anyone without signing in.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "json" in header("content-type") and body_contains("\"slug\"") and body_contains("\"id\"") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Restrict the REST users endpoint, or require authentication for it.
